stories.title: White House confirms death of Iran's Supreme Leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei
stories.summary: Iran's Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei has been killed. He was 86 years old. Khamenei was unwavering in his steadfast antipathy to the US and Israel.

stories.title: President Trump says Iran's Supreme Leader is dead. What happens now?
stories.summary: The United States and Israel launched military strikes against Iran overnight. NPR's Mary Louise Kelly discusses the attacks with NPR's Daniel Estrin and Greg Myre.

stories.title: How some Iranians reacted to attacks on their country
stories.summary: What are people in Iran saying about today's attacks by the U.S. and Israel? We hear from people on the ground who experienced the event as it unfolded.

stories.title: What's next after Iran attack. A former negotiator weighs in.
stories.summary: What will negotiations look like in the weeks after the U.S. and Israel's strikes on Iran? Robert Malley -- who was a lead negotiator on the 2015 Iran Nuclear deal -- offers some insight.

stories.title: New music Friday: Mitski's new album, 'Nothing's About to Happen to Me'
stories.summary: NPR's Ailsa Chang speaks with Raina Douris, host of World Cafe at member station WXPN, about Mitski's new album, Nothing's About to Happen to Me.

stories.title: Australia says no to returning citizens with alleged ISIS ties from Syria
stories.summary: In Australia, the attempted return of people with alleged links to the Islamic State has raised questions about who bears responsibility for nationals who traveled overseas to join the Islamic State.
